group: Collection Vault 5: Periodicals, Movements, Elegies & Bibles
title: Table 5A: 5A: Historic Literary Periodicals, Journals & Editors (1665–1950)
subtitle: Master chronological reference for British & Indian literary periodicals (1665–1950), literary clubs and 82 movements, famous pastoral elegies (who mourned whom), and English Bible translations & dictionaries.
